cards.text: Quick catch-up: Micah from the hill country of Ephraim has a young Levite living in his house (Judges 17). In those days there was no king in Israel, and the tribe of the Danites still hasn't come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel. So they're looking for territory to occupy, and that's a WHOLE tribe apartment hunting at the same time.

cards.question: The Danites send ___ men of valor from Zorah and Eshtaol to spy out the land.

cards.text: The spies head into the hill country of Ephraim and spend the night at, of all the houses in Ephraim, MICAH'S house. Out of every door on that road, friend, they knock on that one.

cards.question: While they're near Micah's house, the spies recognize the young Levite. What do they recognize?

cards.text: They walk right over and ask him, "Who brought you here? What are you doing in this place? Why are you here?" Three questions in one breath is not a hello, friend, that's a job interview.

cards.question: The Levite tells the spies that Micah has done this and that for him, and has hired him to be his ___.
Now that they know he's a priest, the spies ask the Levite to inquire of God for them. What do they want to know?
The Levite answers the spies, "The LORD is watching over your journey."

cards.text: "Go in peace," he says, and the text doesn't say how he got that answer. So the five men leave and come to a city called Laish.

cards.question: When the five spies get to Laish, they see the people living securely, quiet and ___.
Laish has a strong alliance with the Sidonians, who live right next door.

cards.text: The five men get back to Zorah and Eshtaol, and their brothers ask, "What did you find?" Oh, they found something, and they walk in like they just pulled the best batch of their LIVES out of the oven.

cards.question: The spies tell their brothers the land is very good. What do they urge them to do about Laish?

answers.text: Go up and take the land
Send more spies to be sure

cards.question: The spies tell their brothers that God has delivered the land into their hand.
After the spies' report, Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol armed with weapons of war. How many go?

cards.text: They camp at Kiriath-jearim in Judah, and that's why the place west of it is called Mahaneh-dan to this day. These guys camp out ONE time and get a place named after them, and I sat in a junk drawer for YEARS and nobody even named the dust after me.
From there, the six hundred Danites travel to the hill country of Ephraim and come to Micah's house. Same house as the spies' sleepover, friend, but now with six hundred extra guests.

cards.question: At Micah's place, the five spies tell their brothers what one of these houses has inside. What is it?

cards.text: Then the spies add, "Now think about what you should do." So they turn aside to the young Levite's place, the house of Micah, and greet him.

cards.question: While the priest stands at the gate with the six hundred armed men, the five spies go into Micah's house and offer to buy his idols.

cards.text: The priest watches them carry it all out and asks, "What are you doing?" And I get it, friend, with six hundred armed men at the gate that's about all the words I'd find too, and mine would come out as a SQUEAK.

cards.question: The Danites tell the priest to be quiet and come with them. They ask if it's better to be a priest for the house of one person or for a ___ and family in Israel.
When the Danites offer him a whole tribe instead of one house, the priest is glad.

cards.text: So the priest takes the ephod, the household idols and the graven image and goes along, while the Danites put their small children, livestock and possessions out in front. That's a FAST career move, friend, I sat in one drawer for YEARS and this man switches jobs in one conversation.

cards.question: The Danites are some distance from Micah's house when something happens behind them. What is it?

cards.text: The Danites turn around and say to Micah, "What is the matter with you that you have called out such a company?" The NERVE, friend, they're asking him that with his stuff still in their arms.

cards.question: Micah has an answer for the Danites' question. What does he tell them?

answers.text: You took my gods and my priest
You still owe me for the silver
Let me come along with you

cards.question: Micah asks, "What else do I have?" The Danites answer by offering to pay him back for what they took.
The Danites warn Micah not to raise his voice. Micah sees they are too ___ for him, so he turns and goes back home.

cards.text: With Micah's idols and his priest in tow, the Danites go on to Laish. Same quiet and unsuspecting people the spies saw.

cards.question: The six hundred armed Danites reach the quiet people of Laish. What do they do to the city?

answers.text: Strike it and burn it down
Make a peace treaty with it

cards.question: When the Danites attack Laish, Sidon sends help to rescue the city.

cards.text: There's no one to deliver them, because the city is far from Sidon, in a valley near Beth-rehob, and has no alliance with anyone. The Danites rebuild the city and live there.

cards.question: The Danites rename Laish ___, after their forefather who was born to Israel.

cards.text: Then the Danites set up idols for themselves, and Jonathan son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons are priests for the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land. MOSES' family line serving those idols, friend, I read that once, stared at the oven for a minute, and read it AGAIN.

cards.question: The Danites set up Micah's graven image for themselves. How long does it stay there?

answers.text: While the house of God was in Shiloh
Until Micah carried it back to Ephraim
Until the Danites left the city of Dan
